brand.name: CloseLoop + Riverside Luxury Residences
brand.style_ethos: Professional B2B SaaS, restrained premium feel, highly readable.

typography.numbers: font-semibold tracking-tight (Do not use monospace for standard metrics)

resident_portal.layout: Maintain two-column layout. Tighten spacing (reduce padding/margins that cause excessive empty space).
resident_portal.visual_anchor: Make 'How can we help?' text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight as the clear anchor. Tagline: 'Report once. Stay informed. Get resolved.' text-slate-500.
resident_portal.request_card: Elevate with bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-xl p-6. Add hover:shadow-md.
resident_portal.form: Proper input hierarchy. Labels text-sm font-medium text-slate-700. Clean bordered inputs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary.

staff_dashboard.structure: Keep existing tabbed table and layout.
staff_dashboard.business_impact_strip: Strong hierarchy. Value: text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900. Label: text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider.
staff_dashboard.demo_badge: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded uppercase tracking-wider inline-flex items-center.
staff_dashboard.needs_attention: Visually distinguish states. For P0/Failed, add border-l-4 border-l-red-500. For reopened, border-l-4 border-l-amber-500.

issue_detail.previous_resolution_failed: Make this banner high-impact: bg-red-600 text-white p-3 rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2.
issue_detail.timeline: Polished resolution timeline. Use continuous vertical line (border-l-2 border-slate-200) with small status-colored dots.

login.secondary_link: Style 'View Demo Dashboard →' cleanly: text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 underline underline-offset-4 transition-colors.

components.cards: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-xl
components.buttons: Standardize border-radius to rounded-md. Keep primary buttons solid deep-blue.
components.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or small rects (rounded) with subtle background tints and solid text/borders.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for any overlays, headers, or dropdowns.
Strictly polish the UI; do NOT rebuild existing screen structures or add new functionalities.
Ensure transitions on interactive elements like buttons and cards (e.g., hover:shadow-md transition-all).
Keep color meaningful. Use gray/slate for neutral things, and reserve green, red, amber for actual semantic states.
Do not invent new SVGs or logos; lightly adjust typography or layout of the existing CloseLoop + Riverside wordmark.
